_description: Tree Pose (Vrikshasana) shared configuration. Single source of truth for ALL biomechanical thresholds, loaded by BOTH the Python implementation (tree_pose_tracker.py, tree_pose_image.py) and the JavaScript implementation (tree_pose_engine.js via app.js). Changing a value here changes both engines identically.

head._description: Head/nose alignment relative to shoulder midpoint. max_offset is aspect-corrected lateral offset normalized by torso scale. min_visibility is the minimum nose landmark visibility.
